title: Search the audit log for Copilot interactions
summary: Pull the last 7 days of CopilotInteraction audit records with Exchange Online PowerShell and export who used Copilot and where.
code:
Connect-ExchangeOnline

Search-UnifiedAuditLog -RecordType CopilotInteraction `
    -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) -EndDate (Get-Date) -ResultSize 5000 |
  Select-Object CreationDate, UserIds, Operations,
    @{n='App';e={ ($_.AuditData | ConvertFrom-Json).CopilotEventData.AppHost }} |
  Export-Csv .\copilot-audit.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
notes: Unified audit logging must be on (Get-AdminAuditLogConfig shows UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled).
One call returns at most 5000 records; for larger ranges use the Purview Audit search or split the date range.
